formattedAddress: 100, Taiwan, Taipei City, Zhongzheng District, Guangfu Village, 忠孝西路一段122號

text.text:
The flavour is beautifully balanced with real depth and character. Smooth texture bright notes and a clean finish that shows real craftsmanship behind every cup. You can tell the beans are carefully sourced and roasted with intention.

Each sip feels considered and precise not rushed or generic. It is the kind of coffee you remember and genuinely look forward to having again. A must for anyone who truly values artisanal coffee.

text.text: This place is a must go for travellers in Taipei. The ambience is super cute and the service is great. I had to compliment them on there food cause it confused me in a good way. I went for the panini with cheese, omelette and added the peanut butter. Which gave it it a non spicy satay flavour. Which really confused my taste buds. But in a good way, which hasn't happened in a long time. The coffee is ok. A little on the weaker side but you can always expect that in Asian coffee shops. But still  good (when it's your first coffee in 3 weeks).

text.text: Had two different types of coffee, medium and light roasted americano. Fruity flavor from light roasted coffee was great. Highly recommend this place for a coffee lover.

text.text: This is a really lovely looking cafe where the lady owner was working hard on her own the 3 mornings we visited, and the co-owner husband wasn’t there to help her. That was a shame because she needed a bit of help as it was getting busy however when he finally turned up he seemed pretty miserable and grumpy, and uninterested in speaking with the customers. The coffee made each time by the lady was very good although on one visit I had a cheese sandwich which unfortunately wasn’t good.

text.text: This is my favorite place to grab a coffee in the morning in Ximen. The owners are super friendly, the coffee quality is great. They roast their own beans. They also have great breakfast sandwiches made fresh for you. You can also buy some of their coffee beans they roast themselves. Despite being a small shop they manage to do all of this inside the shop.
